faq.q: How do I calculate square footage?
faq.a: Multiply length by width in feet. A 12 by 15 foot room is 180 sq ft. For odd shapes, split the space into rectangles, triangles and circles, work out each one and add them up.

faq.q: How do I calculate square footage of an L-shaped room?
faq.a: Split it into two rectangles that do not overlap. Measure each, multiply length by width, and add the two areas. Use Add a section above to do this automatically.

faq.q: How many square feet are in a square yard?
faq.a: 9 square feet make 1 square yard, because a yard is 3 feet and 3 × 3 = 9. Carpet is often priced per square yard.

faq.q: How do I convert inches to feet for area?
faq.a: Divide inches by 12 before multiplying. 10 feet 6 inches is 10.5 feet. This calculator has separate feet and inch boxes so you do not have to convert.
